author_scoring.EC_F1: Report author Entailment/Contradiction precision/recall/F1 and arithmetic/harmonic means. No goldsupport gives author NaN recall/F1; encode null+UNDEFINED_AUTHOR_NAN, required undefined mean gate NOT_PASS.
author_scoring.denominator: All12 three-class rows, one fixed hypothesis. No binary filtering.
author_scoring.scope: Helper adaptation; not complete evaluate_all classification binary-filtered or paper/full17 task.

confidence: Raw T1, no calibration or fitted posterior.

decision.prediction: Canonical-first argmax of reordered raw FP32 logits; exact ties favor N then E then C.
decision.probabilities: Stable log-softmax from actual FP32 logits; no clipping, temperature fit, calibration or outcome-dependent transformations.

frozen_dev_gates.resources_and_physical_closure: all SOURCE-frozen limits, exact readouts and independent owned-process closure pass

latency: Actual perarm tokenization/forward/readertotal p50/p95; separate batchcase span includes queue and modelinit, excludes sharedinitialBGEinit; no publisher/isolated latency claim.
numeric_coverage: Fixed literal substring/offset diagnostic only, not exhaustive extraction/correctness or class override.

proper_scores.Brier: Mean over fixed12 of sum3 squared probability errors.
proper_scores.NLL: Unclipped shift-first stable source FP32-logit logsoftmax, reordered with identical canonical mapping.
proper_scores.NLL_clipped_1e_12: Diagnostic only. p_gold/underflow/clip counts retained; never the gate NLL.
